main_body: Two wooden posts at left and right with a cream cloth hammock sagging between them in a U-shaped curve
top_band: none — the posts are seen as flat vertical bars with a 1-2px cap highlight at rows 6-7 (orange); the hammock is a front-view curved sling with no horizontal surface visible
evidence: Reading the post column (x about 5): row 6 has a light orange highlight, then the post continues as a uniform orange-brown face down to a dark base at rows 29-31. The tops are only a 1-2px rim with no top surface, and the base has no visible top face. The hammock is a side-on U-shaped curve with no cloth top surface visible from above, so it is a flat front elevation. This fails the frame requirement that beams and base show top faces.

style.evidence: The posts use about 3-4 orange-brown steps with a dark brown outline that is tinted to the wood, which is good. They are flat vertical stripes with almost no grain or knots, so the large post areas are flat fills. The cream hammock has about 4 tones but little texture or weave. Compared with the stall and well references, which carry many colours per tile, texture and detail, this piece is much sparser and flatter.
